label: released-0.7-b3c7d2c
scope: Linux warm-cache fresh processes. Not cold-disk, target-device FPS, Apple Silicon, total-system/GPU memory or child-playtest evidence.
measurement_notes: RSS sampled directly from /proc before any mesh-array or image readback.
Checkpoints use five RSS samples separated by 10ms. Startup readiness is eight process frames; construction is synchronous scene load/instantiate/add-child.
One excluded warmup per backend; repeated fresh processes share warm OS/import/shader caches.
External update query suppressed while its client node remains allocated. RNG fixed and ambient time scale zero for comparable scenes.
Optional geometry builds on first reveal and may remain cached when returning to window. Inventory and captures run in separate fresh processes.
Geometry channel bytes are estimates, not RSS. No headless MultiMesh transform or bounds readback.

full_world.scope: Separate inventory process. Mesh channel payload estimates exclude allocator, textures, materials, driver and MultiMesh instance-buffer overhead. Triangle multiplicity is not rendered work. No MultiMesh transform/bounds readback.

window.scope: Separate inventory process. Mesh channel payload estimates exclude allocator, textures, materials, driver and MultiMesh instance-buffer overhead. Triangle multiplicity is not rendered work. No MultiMesh transform/bounds readback.

window_return.scope: Separate inventory process. Mesh channel payload estimates exclude allocator, textures, materials, driver and MultiMesh instance-buffer overhead. Triangle multiplicity is not rendered work. No MultiMesh transform/bounds readback.

route.scope: Regular production controller steps after full-world reveal and return. Fixed time scale freezes ambient animation, not explicit controller steps; no actor position or shelter assignments.

field_notes.scope: Field Notes opened from a fresh title scene after other visual evidence; no manual camera restoration.
